from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported 'cash received from other operating activities' from their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if provided")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of '收到其他与经营活动有关的现金' in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., 2024 年 1-3 月")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial statement, e.g., 合并现金流量表")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Optional verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
